releases.displayName: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor Update – August 25th 2026

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973336/e86ac81507d8af6c3289b3626b4012deae4c1acf.jpg"]
Our latest update for Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is out today!

As a thank you for your incredible support for the game and in celebration of the Dovetail Direct, this update includes a free bonus livery, featuring Thomas in his LBSC Anniversary Green. You can choose this livery in both Timetable Mode and Explore Mode.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973336/99b5c2adce94ef6b2f366eb43e5153922df45d75.jpg"]

The excitement doesn’t stop there! Tune into Dovetail Direct: Summer 2026 tonight at 17:00 UTC / 13:00 EDT / 10:00 PDT. Join us where we'll share an exclusive meet the team segment with the team who made the game and share some big news about the game's future. Don't miss the livestream!
Dovetail Direct - August 25th, 17:00 UTC / 13:00 EDT / 10:00 PDT

This update will be going live from 12:00 UTC, and please note that updates may take up to 24-hours to release across each platform. Some platforms can also download and install updates while in Standby mode, without your notice.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973336/41403063e3bd0b060cab6577347931533cbbc6af.jpg"]
Core Game Updates
Thomas in his LBSC Green Livery – Selectable in Timetable and Explore Mode
Added Steam Deck Support
Menu and Settings
Updated the Explore menu design - to make it easier for players to be able to add engines, set destinations, contact the signaller and access the Map
Minor updates to the game credits
Updated Settings to remove additional settings that have no function
Fixed some subtitles that don’t fit in the speech bubbles during stories
Fixed localisation line breaks and characters not appearing correctly
Fixed a reverser thumbnail appearing incorrectly
Fixed an issue where the Fast Travel menu wasn't closing
Fixed an issue where the "Set Destination" prompt was obscuring the tracks as it was appearing by default
Fixed instances where the UI wasn't changing to reflect a controller being plugged in on PC
Fixed an issue where tool tips couldn't be re-enabled after being turned off
Fixed an issue where Knapford Harbour and Wellsworth were being incorrectly identified in the Map
Fixed an issue on Nintendo Switch where the button callouts on the bottom left would become blurry
Fixed an issue where loading screen tip text was inconsistent
Removed the compass from the Route Map
Timetables, Stories and Gameplay
Adjusted Gordon's whistle timing during James and the Van Story
Fixed some timetables that were causing instant derailments on service start
Fixed an issue where Gordon's Challenges weren't updating progression correctly
Fixed an issue where the Leaves story suddenly changed weather abruptly while playing
Fixed an issue where the First Class Engine story didn't fail the player at a Stop Location objective
Fixed an issue where the throttle would become broken after opening and closing the pause menu while driving.
Fixed an issue with services on timetable mode not being consistent across the different platforms
For reference, PC and Gen 9 platforms should have the following service counts for each character -
Diesel – 19 Services
Emily – 64 Services
Gordon – 64 Services
James – 71 Services
Percy – 49 Services
Thomas – 51 Services
Route and Scenery Art
Fixed an issue where a poster at Cronk station was clipping into the wall
Fixed an issue where a poster at Sports Field Halt was clipping into the wall
Fixed an issue where the platform signs were floating at Knapford station
Fixed an issue where players could clip into the fire buckets at Knapford station
Fixed an issue where the oak trees near Crovan's Gate Station were bending over dramatically
Fixed an issue where Tidmouth Sheds had a gap in the building textures
Fixed an issue at Maron station where the rain and snow were falling through the roof
Fixed an issue on Nintendo Switch where Knapford station was loading too slowly during the Thomas and Gordon scenario
Fixed an issue where carriages' couplers would clip into stop buffers
Adjusted Bertie's face a bit to align better with the metal border around it
Engines and Rolling Stock
Fixed an issue where the couplers weren't animating properly on trains
Fixed an issue where James' reverser was hard to reach in the cab
Fixed an issue where Diesel's face wasn't responding to sounding his own horn
Fixed an issue where AI trains would be driving at night without headlamps on
Fixed an issue where Gordon was still blowing steam despite being broken down during the Emily and the Express story

Thank you all so much for your feedback and support. Please continue to give your feedback and suggestions to Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor through the Dovetail Games Discord and the official Wonders of Sodor Forums. Your feedback helps to make the experience even better!

Want to share your journey, chat with fellow fans, or hear directly from the team? Join our official Discord server, where we’ll be sharing updates and celebrating all things Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor. We can’t wait to hear about your adventures.

releases.displayName: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor – Patch Notes 27th April 2026

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973336/c2fffae0c3bd76c66455fd98cf5d79fd288edccf.jpg"]

Hello everyone, today we have exciting news about the first major update coming to Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor, built using your community feedback with changes we hope will make the experience even better!
This patch will be coming to all platforms next week, on Monday, April 27th, 2026, at 10am UTC. We’ve detailed the full list of changes in this article for you to view below:
Full Changelog
Gameplay & Services
Adjusted frequency of red signals
Added new checkpoints after cutscenes in several scenarios
Added a tool tip explaining the accelerator
Moved stopping points on Jack Frost scenario to reduce SPAD risks at red signals
Enabled checkpoints on console platforms
Fixed an issue causing the Live Map to intermittently freeze
Fixed an issue causing the left stick on controllers to stop working
Fixed controller switching to driver’s seat when going back into First Person camera
Removed checkpoints that caused players to derail upon coupling in several scenarios
Changed signal behaviour so that players are slowed down when approaching red signals to prevent derailing at excessive speeds
Diesel's first service of the day now has a stop at Ffarquahr instead of going via Ffarquahr for his instruction at Ffarquahr to try to prevent the player from getting softlocked
James first service with the tanker wagons, and his return service with them, have been updated to ensure that SPADs do not happen unexpectedly
Adjusted the ending position of previous shunt procedure before James' final service to move to the sheds changed to prevent James rolling forward on that service before uncoupling
Fixed an issue with Diesel's move to the harbour from Ffarquhar. The stop can now be passed through without failing, enabling the player to reverse to the marker
Fixed an issue with throttle incorrectly invoking and revoking when pausing
Fixed an issue in Emily and the Express where the first narrator line would sometimes not display correctly
Fixed an issue where services involving the turntable would sometimes fail the player
Fixed a wrong signal during Gordon’s 07:29 service
Fixed Challenges not updating for Thomas after completing ‘Thomas and Gordon’
Final ‘Stop At’ objectives now allow the player to reverse if they do not SPAD and complete the objective as expected
Knapford Yard replaced with Knapford in both departure and arrival locations to allow the destination to be displayed in these circumstances
Corrected the spelling of the word "Chuckled" in the subtitles for Percy's Driver during Jack Frost
Various fixes to several typos in scenario subtitles
Locos & Characters
Updated all formations using the Express Coaches (Red and Green variants) to fix an issue where the brake coach was flipped the wrong way
Fixed Sir Topham Hatt being too blurry in some scenarios
Fixed wheels moving after cars come to a stop
Fixed an issue where Emily's facial expressions were not being updated correctly
Fixed an issue where green flickering was appearing on all trains
Fixed an issue where Gordon was still producing smoke despite being broken down
Fixed the reversers of some locos not animating correctly
Fixed Express Coach formations so that the last coach is placed the correct way
Removed formations larger than 5 trucks/vans + brakevan as Percy was incapable of pulling them
Removed Sir Topham Hatt’s speaking animation
Route & Environment
Adjusted and improved lighting along several tunnels, mainly Henry’s Tunnel
Adjusted the fog levels at Vicarstown
Adjusted turntables to remove the gap between rails
Adjusted signals around the tunnel south of Vicarstown near Killdane to make them more visible
Fixed various rail joint rendering issues
Fixed areas of missing collision on the far Knapford platform
Fixed issues with rocks and buildings popping on screen when loading
Fixed an issue where you can fall through a gap in the floor by the turntable
Fixed an issue where a scenario start marker for ‘Thomas Goes Fishing’ was clipping with Elsbridge station
Fixed areas where weather could pass through Cronk’s canopies
Removed collision from gantries and all signal posts, so that the camera can pass through
Removed floating trees near Vicarstown
Removed floating grass at Whispering Woods
Removed Ffarquhar sign on the Wellsworth station building
Menus & User Interface
Added a "Reload Checkpoint" button to the pause menu
Added brightness calibration menu to Display settings and updated design
Adjusted sizing of subtitle bubbles
Adjusted the height of the hitbox for the navigation bar slightly to allow for hovering Whispering Woods from zoomed out easier
Moved the UI navigation buttons to the top
Updated the Dovetail Live News UI
Updated the Map Legend to include an explanation for the red exclamation mark (!)
Updated the cursor on the Main Map so that it’s more visible
Updated visuals for the Percy Poster so that it fits the menu thumbnail
Updated credits with more names
Updated Station Markers so that they point more accurately
Fixed posters not unlocking after completing Tier 1 challenges
Fixed an issue where players were stuck on the Profile Selection menu
Fixed an issue where if you signed up to a new DTL account it wouldn’t complete challenges
Fixed an issue with the HUD not updating based on the HUD type in the settings
Fixed an issue with the photo mode staying visible when replaying a service
Fixed an issue with news not showing up on the news section of the main menu
Fixed an issue with inconsistent font sizes on loading screen tips
Fixed the HUD type options to correctly remove and open parts of the HUD when changed
Fixed an issue causing tip text on the loading screen to overlap with the loading icon
Fixed some text overlap issues on the photo gallery and challenge menu tabs
Fixed icons switching to mouse and keyboard when flicking controller input
Fixed blurry "Walk Around" icon
Fixed inconsistent font and fixed door symbol
Removed “Next Scenario” option when the player fails a scenario
Removed “Load Checkpoint” option appearing in the menu after completing a scenario
Removed various unused UI settings, including Next Speed Limit HUD, Next Signal Marker HUD, references to AWS and PZB , and “Return to Timetable” option from UI
Audio
Emily should now produce sounds when coupling to the Red Branch Coaches
Fixed some incorrect footstep sounds
Settings & Controls
Updated default controller settings so that Track Rumble Vibration is off by default
Fixed an issue with Photo mode weather preset not working
Fixed Contact Signaller keyboard input not working as expected
Thank you all so much for your continued feedback and support. You have created a wonderful community, and it’s fantastic to see so many of you enjoying the game.

Beyond this update, coming next week, we will continue to support Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor with future patches and updates to the game. Alongside further changes based on your feedback, our next patch will include key improvements, including:
Explore Mode Improvements - Updates to help make the usability and functions of Explore Mode easier to understand.

Want to share your journey, chat with fellow fans, or hear directly from the team? Join our official Discord server, where we’ll be sharing updates and celebrating all things Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor. We can’t wait to hear about your adventures.
Need support whilst playing Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor? Feel free to check in via our player support options so that we’re able to assist you.
